title: pangea-operator chart values
description: Schema covering the footgun-prone subset of pangea-operator chart values. Validates at helm lint / template / install time so consumers get fail-loud errors on typo'd or required-but-missing fields rather than silent runtime failures. Full Rust-struct→schema generation lives in a follow-up workstream; today's schema covers the OperatorPolicy surface, the embedded-Ruby gem-auth dependency, and the logLevel toggle.

logLevel.description: tracing-subscriber EnvFilter directive for the operator. Threaded into RUST_LOG by the deployment template. Comma-separated <target>=<level>.

useEmbeddedRuby.description: When true, operator runs the magnus+CRuby compiler in-process (no sidecar). Requires `gemAuth.tokenSecret.name` to be set. The deployment template enforces the dependency at render time but having the schema validate it lets `helm lint` / `helm template` catch missing values before pod start.

gemAuth.description: Authentication for fetching operator-runtime gems (only used when useEmbeddedRuby=true).

name.description: Name of the Secret holding the gem-fetch token.

operatorPolicy.description: OperatorPolicy/default singleton CR shipped by the chart. Mirrors the Rust spec at src/crd/operator_policy.rs.

create.description: Whether to render the CR. Disable to manage the policy externally.

globalSuspendReason.description: Operator-readable reason surfaced in logs + Events when globalSuspend=true.

controllerSuspend.description: Per-controller suspend. Each field maps to a ControllerKind variant.

workspaceSuspend.description: Per-workspace tri-state pause. Both maps default empty; missing entries inherit from controller/global layers.

catalogs.description: Per-catalog overrides keyed by WorkspaceCatalog name. Cascades to children unless a child template overrides.

WorkspaceSuspendEntry.description: A single per-workspace decision: state + optional reason.

state.description: Tri-state decision. `inherit` (or omit) falls through; `paused` freezes regardless of more-general state; `active` carves out from a more-general pause.

reason.description: Optional human-readable note surfaced in skip logs + the policy_skipped_total metric label.

allOf.description: When useEmbeddedRuby=true, gemAuth.tokenSecret.name must be set to a non-empty Secret name.
